text:
B: Alright! Another Liam. How you doing, mate?
A: Liam squared! Sound, mate, sound. Ilkeston, between Nottingham and Derby. You?
B: Warrington. I've got to say, I'm dead jealous of that hot sauce shelf.
A: Them's just the display ones. I've got about fifteen more downstairs, my mum moans every time she opens the cupboard. You into it?
B: Love it. I do a Korean fried chicken at the weekend with a gochujang glaze, use every pan in the house...
A: Nah, sorry, but gochujang's not hot though, is it? That's sweet. You want a proper Reaper sauce. I've got one that'd strip paint off a door.
B: It's not about the heat, it's the flavour, mate.
A: That's what people say when they can't handle it.
B: Ha! Go on then, I'll eat anything. I'll tell the waiter if it's not hot enough an' all. Love your decks, by the way. Oh, wait, they're mine. What are you into?
A: House and techno mostly. I go to nights in Nottingham, the odd festival. You DJ, then?
B: Now and then, a bar in town. Disco, house, bit of northern soul. I got a record off Discogs this week and it came warped, I'm fuming. Thirty quid that were.
A: Nightmare. You been to Berlin? That's the one for me, you know? The clubs, the murals, all the history. Best city in Europe, no question.
B: Been twice! Couldn't get in Berghain though. Bouncer looked at me and just shook his head.
A: I got in first go.
B: Course you did.
A: Swear down! You've just got to look bored. You was probably smiling at him. Fatal.
B: Probably, yeah. I can't help it, it's the job. I sell cars, a dealership on the edge of Warrington. You?
A: Sparky. Domestic, bit of commercial. I'm going self-employed in a couple of years, EV chargers and solar. That's where it's all going, isn't it.
B: Mate, we should be talking. Every other customer now wants an electric, and the first thing they ask is who's putting the charger in. I could be passing them to you.
A: Yeah? I'd sort you out a drink for every one. Cash, obviously.
B: Obviously. What's the paperwork like, going on your own? My boss reckons my admin's a disgrace.
A: Er, you just get an accountant, don't you? That's what everyone keeps asking me today, the paperwork.
B: Same as me, then. Do you play football at all?
A: Five-a-side every Wednesday. I'm the one shouting at everyone. Ref included.
B: No way, Wednesday's mine too! Someone's ankle went last week, it were a bloodbath. Who do you follow?
A: Forest. Season ticket's too much so I get to a few games, watch the rest in the pub.
B: Liverpool on the telly, Wolves in the flesh. Rugby league.
A: Rugby league, nah. I can't get into it. They just run into each other.
B: That's football with no diving, mate. Japan's my next one, by the way, I'm properly booking it this year.
A: Japan's mine! Or Mexico City. Tokyo first though, I've seen documentaries on the architecture, unreal. When you going?
B: Well, Jess books everything, so whenever she...
